title: Cultural Compass: A Framework for Organizing Societal Norms to Detect Violations in Human-AI Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Generating diverse open-ended conversational prompts based on user intent, and using an LLM-as-a-judge pipeline to detect whether the model's responses violate country-specific sociocultural norms (e.g., etiquette, communication styles) sourced from the NormAd dataset.
